g.text: RIGOR-RS v3 : Autonomous ML Research Agent Architecture
TikTok TechJam 2026 (Track #2) • Benchmark: KuaiRand-Pure • Primary Evaluation: NDCG@10 & Recall@50 (Click Relevance)
• Analyzes sparsity, category tails & cold starts
• Measures opposing gradient updates in shared layers
• Semantic search query for detected local weakness
• Fetches literature metadata, DOIs, open-access text
• Converts paper claims into structured YAML cards
• Filters out hype/unfeasible ideas before coding
• 1 Single Causal Hypothesis + Parent Run ID
• Compares official validation score vs baseline
• Feeds evidence into next research iteration
• Applies minimal code diff from Code Agent
• Enforces contract file boundaries & lint checks
• Fast Preflight Pass / Early Failure Catch
• Atomic Checkpoint Vault with SHA256 hashes
• Real-time GPU VRAM, Memory, & Compute Tracking
• Source of Truth: Organizer Evaluator Script
• Checks convergence: ΔMetric < ε for N iterations
• Resource Watchdog: GPU Hours, Wall-Time & Tokens
• Replays winning path in clean environment (100% check)
• Runs single final inference on Sealed Test Features
• Terminal Action: No feedback loop allowed
• Ground-truth click labels for NDCG & Recall
• Append-only run events, diffs, & metric receipts
• Triggers on: Checksum mismatch, test data leakage
• Action: Safe terminal halt (Zero corruption risk)
• GPU Out-of-Memory (OOM) ➔ Halve batch, 2× grad accum
• Diverging NaN Loss ➔ Rollback to last valid checkpoint
• Rate limits ➔ Exponential backoff & cache reuse
• Handles: Syntax errors, PyTorch tensor shape mismatches
• Receives traceback + failing diff in isolated sandbox
• Rollback to stable parent if repair fails
• Output: predictions.csv (Organized by Official Evaluator Schema) • Validation-Best Confirmed Artifact • Deterministic Clean-Environment Replay Receipt
• Full SQLite Ledger & Git Diff Trail • Machine-Readable Intervention Count = 0 • Total GPU-Hours & LLM Token Accounting
